# Anatomy Iso Object 机关讲解 — Style Prompt

> 一个概念 = 一台能转起来的真机器。看懂机器，就懂了概念。
> 来源：https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy （MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Ryan）。我们只学它的方法和质感，物体每片重新发明，不照搬它的示例物体。

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
- 核心不变量：**物体就是解释**。先找一台真实存在、一眼能叫出名字的机器/仪器/家具，它的运转方式和概念一一对应（例：缓存键命中＝弹子锁所有销对齐才转动；一个 GPU 上下文服务多个画布＝一个打印头巡访 16 个孔的龙门绘图机）。必须能用一句话说清「什么在动、动代表什么」。
- 不是：方块+箭头+标签的流程图；漂浮的「层」板子；一整块平板上画几条线；蓝图风（引线、编号气泡、尺寸箭头、虚线隐藏边）；线框透视；满屏彩色。

## 2. Materials & rendering
- 等轴测实体：默认方位 45°（35–60° 让承载机构的面朝向观众），仰角 30°（要看进容器内部可抬到 ~44°）。
- **零件密度**：一张图 40–80 个零件（主体复杂时 80–150）；密度来自结构（脚、导轨、限位块、衬套、旋钮、螺丝、刻度尺、铭牌），不来自纹理。每个零件都坐在另一个零件上、和邻居对齐、有用途。
- **两层看**：1× 一眼是一台清楚的机器；放大 4× 每个区域仍有真东西可看。空白面＝没做完。
- **明暗**：每个实体有真实厚度，侧面四档明暗（相邻约 3% 亮度差，很克制），顶面最亮，主板有倒角高光，底座下有柔和晕影。
- 线条：细线 ~0.6 px（@600 宽画布），每根线必须落在面、线或端点上，不许悬空断；纹理（螺栓点、肋条、刻度）要么止于真实边缘，要么淡出，绝不半路硬停。
- 绘制顺序：后→前、下→上；包裹件（弹簧、框架）拆前后两半；管线逐段按深度排。

## 3. Colour logic（分层：主件 / 辅件 / 背景）
- 单色为主，色值全部走 token（浅色主题优先，深色是可选）。
- 背景层：纸色卡片＝填充色，`lo` 给底座、脚、地面；`faint` 给凹槽、内嵌线、地面网格。
- 辅件：结构（立柱、导轨、框架、滑台、外壳）用 `mid`。
- 主件：被解释的东西用 `hi`；**此刻要看的那一个**用 `lit`（白边+更亮顶面），全图只有一个。
- 颜色只在「颜色本身就是主题」时出现；液体也是本图墨色的淡染，不另起饱和色。

## 4. Type & subtitles（框卡版式）
- 机器放在一张框卡里，占卡面 55–65%，四角不被碰到：左上 `Fig n`，右上短标题（等宽大写字距拉开），左下交互/操作提示，右下**实时读数**（短、带真实单位，如 `block 1 · reads 18.0 px`）。
- 图例和一句真实图注放在卡片下方；画面里最多一个刻在零件面上的小铭牌字，其余文字一律不进画面。
- 字体：角标/读数用等宽体；图注用无衬线。中文片角标与读数用等宽或得意黑，图注/字幕用霞鹜文楷（均 OFL，见 film 规则），字号守导演下限。

## 5. Motion quality
- 时间驱动不按帧步进；所有运动朝目标指数缓动（τ≈0.1–0.3 s）或真实弹簧（真实刚度/阻尼）——有重量、有惯性，绝不瞬移贴光标。
- 缓慢、可跟随；一次只动一个主件。无人操作时跑一段「闲置巡演」把要点演一遍。
- **数字与模型同源**：读数、指针、零件位置全部来自同一个小纯函数模型；读数从「零件此刻实际在哪」取值，相位词和数字取自同一瞬间，绝不各算各的。查不到的真值不写（不编数据）。

## 6. Camera grammar
- 交互原版：相机固定，等轴测，物体居中。改成影片时见 §12。

## 7. Sound palette
- 原项目无声。成片沿用我们的规则：BGM 全程不断，−14 LUFS，真峰值 ≤ −1.5 dBTP；机械音效（咔哒、齿轮、弹簧）只在关键零件动作点加，轻。

## 8. Native moves
- 滑台滑动、指针转到读数、柱塞随高度起落。
- **拆解展开（exploded view）**：各总成沿装配轴错峰弹开、再合拢，全程逐帧重排深度。
- 主件变 `lit`（视线锚点切换）。
- 读数随零件实时变化。

## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
- 太抽象（叠板）或太平（一块大板）——同一个解法：换成真实机器 + 更多小零件。
- 管线穿过管线/实体、线头悬空、纹理半路停、曲面阶梯色块——放大 4× 都会露馅。
- 为了一张截图手调深度顺序，结果别的帧坏掉——先量再看。
- 读数和指针不同源，出现矛盾数字。

## 10. Engine
- 纯代码：原项目 Node（零依赖）生成 SVG 单页，`kit/iso-kit.mjs` 提供实体/圆柱/刻度/旋钮/弹簧等原语；流体、光、焦散用 WebGL 层夹在前后两层 SVG 之间；可选 3D 模式。
- 自检（不变量）：做完逐个关节放大到 4× 截图并看；线头检查为 0；有管线/圆件时审计 0 失败；手机宽度 390 仍可读；无控制台报错。
- 成片渲染：每帧是 t 的纯函数，用户规则（2026-11-01）**正式渲染只在 Mac mini 上做**。

## 11. Variation space / known gaps for next version
- 尚无竖屏影片实测（test.mp4 待 Mac mini）；
- 中文角标/读数的等宽中文字体待定；
- 深色主题与我们其他风格的衔接待试；3D 模式是 beta，先不用于成片。

## 12. 改成动画短片时怎么用
- **镜头跟零件走**：用等轴测相机做缓慢环绕（方位角在 35–60° 内摆动）、缓推到当前 `lit` 零件、退远看整机；不做硬切，换镜靠零件形状/运动延续。
- **零件逐个出场卡口播**：底座→结构→机构→读数，按装配顺序落位（带轻微弹性落下）；**口播关键词出现的那一帧，对应零件立刻动**（±1 帧，变化必须肉眼明显），同时该零件切为 `lit`。
- **拆解展开讲结构**：讲「由什么组成」时整机错峰炸开成总成，逐个点名、再合拢；合拢那一下卡在句尾/重拍。
- **读数翻牌**：右下读数随模型滚动或翻牌，数字只来自同一个模型和查实的资料，查不到不写。
- **竖屏 1080×1920**：框卡占上 2/3，Fig/标题在上，读数在下，字幕在卡片下方安全区；**横屏 1920×1080**：机器居左 60%，图注/字幕在右栏。
- **节奏放慢**：一句一个零件动作，留呼吸；运动全部带惯性。
- **不要像 AI 做的**：零件要能叫出名字、每根线落地、无乱码贴图、无滤镜光效堆砌；一个高亮色以内。
- **无广告**：不出现品牌 logo、带货口播或二维码；不用任何人的 logo 或真实照片。

# Brand Title Opener 厂牌滚轮片头 — Style Prompt

> newbeer.lee 的厂牌片头：前半句踏拍逐字打出 → 光标变成选中带 → 滚轮滚**过**主题词 → 落在**反差词**上停稳一拍（被否定的选择）→ 反向**旋回主题词** → 在音乐落点 D 锁定变黄 → 定格 1 秒 → 统一退场交给正片。
> **主题词是参数：可以是数字（「10倍」），也可以是词（「暂停」「永远」）。两种写法同等地位，同一套引擎、同一套时间、同一个锁定动作。**
> 来源：自家片《如果你的反应快10倍》v7 片头滚轮（2026-11-10）→ 本条目 v3（用户 2026-11-10「10倍这里做一个反差选择，最后旋转回我们的主题词」；「可以，如果以后需要最后滚动的关键词不是数字，的时候更好用，都记下来，给风格库」）。
> 本文只写不变量。逐帧数值以本文为准；demo/ 里的引擎是同源实现。

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
- 一个 5 秒左右的**厂牌片头动作**，不是某一部片子的标题。任何片子都能套：换前半句、换词表、换主题词、换皮肤、换 D，动作不变。
- 核心戏剧：观众先看到一个**错误/相反的选择**被摆上来（反差词停稳可读），然后滚筒**反转**回到主题词，在重拍上「砰」地锁定——「不是这个，是**这个**」。
- **动画逻辑所有片子共用，只换皮肤**（pixel / cartoon / data / cinema，可新增）。节奏、阶段、卡点、版式、选中带、锁定高亮、签名位置一律不随皮肤变。
- 主题词两种形态（**一等用法，任选其一**）：

| | 数字例 | 词例 |
|---|---|---|
| 前半句 `--prefix` | 如果你的反应快 | 如果你能 |
| 词表 `--values`（**末项 = 主题词**） | 2倍,3倍,4倍,5倍,6倍,7倍,8倍,9倍,10倍 | 加速,倒流,跳过,复制,暂停 |
| 反差词 `--contrast` | 1倍 | 加速 |
| 后缀 `--suffix` | （无） | 时间 |
| 锁定后读作 | 如果你的反应快**10倍** | 如果你能**暂停**时间 |

- 不是：数字计数器（词表可以全是词）；老虎机/抽奖（结果不随机，主题词是写死的答案）；过冲回弹（v2 的过冲段已作废）；花字模板（没有逐字飞入、没有渐显半字）。

## 2. Materials & rendering
- 纯代码：Canvas 2D，每帧是 t 的纯函数（单一时钟、固定随机种子、无 setTimeout/CSS 动画）；Chromium 无头逐帧截图 → ffmpeg H.264 CRF18 yuv420p bt709。
- 画面层：背景（皮肤）→ 前半句 → 滚轮框（框底 + 导轨 + 端盖 + 上下渐隐遮罩 + 选中带）→ 滚轮行 → 锁定冲击（闪白、外扩环、粒子、光晕）→ 后缀/副标题 → 签名。
- 滚轮行：行距 1.10×字号；邻行透明度 α(d)=1−0.55|d|（|d|≤1），再往外线性到 1.6 行消失；缩放 1−0.10·min(|d|,1.5)，纵向再乘 cos(0.42·min(|d|,1.6))（滚筒透视）；框内上下各 0.50×字号线性渐隐。
- 运动模糊：0.4 帧快门（144°）7 次采样，**先各自画到临时层再加法平均**（静止帧与单次绘制完全相同，不变暗）；只有快门内实际位移 >1.6 px（×min(W,H)/1080）才开。
- 框：内宽 = max(全部词 + 反差词) + 2×0.12×字号；内高 2.30 行距；选中带高 1.07 行距，上下两条线，Bo→D 线条以 0.8 s 周期呼吸（0.80±0.20）。
- 环境层（背景网格/颗粒/圆点）运动幅度 ≤ 主层 15%。

## 3. Colour logic
- 每个皮肤有：背景、正文、出字热色、accent（光标/选中带/下划线/签名里的点）、**锁定黄**、白热、光晕、框底、导轨四段、闪白、色差两色、粒子、签名色。
- **锁定色恒为黄色系，色相约 40–52°，全片最高亮的暖色——这是厂牌识别色。** 锁定前（含反差停顿期）字行里不允许出现锁定黄。
- 现值：pixel #FFE859 / cartoon #FFD23F / data #FFD95A / cinema #F2C45A（锁定字填充可按皮肤做渐变，但落点必须在这个色相段）。
- 出字热色：出现帧 75% 热色，约 0.2 s 后常驻 22%（前半句一直略带颜色，不回到平白）。
- 反差词：用普通滚轮行颜色（22% 热色），**不变黄**；它落定时选中带线条暗 25%，表示「不是它」。

## 4. Type & subtitles
- 字体全部 SIL OFL 1.1：pixel = Fusion Pixel 12px（字号取 12 倍数，缩放/位移量化 1/24 字号）；cartoon = 站酷快乐体 ZCOOL KuaiLe；data = 得意黑 Smiley Sans Oblique；cinema = 思源宋体 Noto Serif SC Black；备用思源黑体 Noto Sans SC Black；签名 Noto Sans Mono CJK SC。来源与版本见 demo/FONTS.md。
- 版式（1080 基准，其它分辨率按 min(W,H)/1080 等比）：
  - 16:9 单行：主字号 180 px；整行（前半句 + 0.16FS + 主题词×1.04 + 后缀）≤ 0.88W，超了自动缩字号；行中心 y=0.437H；**整句按锁定后的最终全句（主题词宽度）水平居中**，后缀出现不重排。
  - 9:16 两行：可用宽 W−240；第 1 行前半句 FS1=min(120, 840/字数)，行中心 0.38H；第 2 行滚轮 + 后缀，FS2=1.30×FS1，**框顶 = 第 1 行字底 + 0.15×FS1**；全部在 y 360–1420 安全带内，签名右缘避开右侧 120 px 平台按钮区。
  - 滚轮字左对齐在 xw = 前半句末 + 0.16×字号；所有值（包括比主题词短的反差词）共用左缘，锁定字紧贴前半句。
- **整字原则**：字永远不透明度 1，一帧整字出现，入场只用缩放与下坠（s 1.28 → 0.958 → 1.019 → 1.00，上跳 −8% 字号后沉降，约 0.15 s 落稳），无渐显、无半字、无旋转；新字先画、旧字后画（放大的新字不盖前一个字）。
- 主题词与反差词的长度：**可以是任何字数的词或数字+单位**；框宽按最宽词自动算。词例里词长尽量一致（2 字词最好），否则滚动中框会显得空。
- 副标题 `--sub`：D+0.35 s 起逐字，0.6×主字号。后缀 `--suffix`：D+0.12 s 起逐字，接在锁定字（按 1.04 放大后）右缘 + 0.02×字号。
- 签名：小写 `newbeer.lee`，「.」用 accent 色（唯一品牌色点），其余签名色，整体透明度 0.60，34 px；16:9 右缘 W−96、基线 H−80；9:16 右缘 W−140、基线 1400。

## 5. Motion quality
阶段（时间一律从锁定时刻 D 倒推；D = round(drop×fps)/fps）：

1. **光标**：CurOn 出现，0.10 s 长到满高；宽 0.08×字号、高 0.86×字号，accent 色；未打字时踏拍硬闪（拍点亮、半拍灭），开始打字后常亮，每出一字跳到末字右缘 + 0.04×字号。
2. **前半句逐字踏拍打出**：每字落在音乐网格点（有拍点表用拍点表，无则从 D 往回按 4/4、默认 112.7 BPM 铺网格，D 视为强拍）；细分优先 8 分 → 16 分 → 16 分三连 → 32 分；首字尽量落强拍；**一帧最多一个字**；打字 tick 落在精确拍点，画面取最近帧（误差 ≤ ½ 帧）。
3. **光标 → 选中带变形 + 框展开**（Bo → Rs，OPEN 0.16 s，可压到 0.12）：光标矩形 lerp 成选中带矩形，框高从带高展开到框高，内容过半才出现起始值。容器先开、内容后进。
4. **正滚**（Rs → Rc，ROLL3 = 1.03 s）：p 从 0 二次减速到 N+1（N = 主题行 = 词表末项，N+1 = 反差行）；棘轮 p = b − K·sin(2πb)/(2π)，K = 0.35·(1 − smoothstep(0.8,1,u))；**第一次经过主题词时不停死**（棘轮仍在，速度不为 0）。
5. **反差停顿**（Rc → Rh，CHOLD = 0.19 s）：反差词在选中带正中静止**可读 ≥6 帧**（30 fps）。**不变黄、不闪白、不屏震、不响锁定冲击**；选中带「紧一下」（高度最多收 6%，0.16 s 回原，线条暗 25%）。
6. **旋回**（Rh → D，BACK = 0.16 s）：反向滚回主题行，τ = ((t−Rh)/BACK)^1.4，p = N+1 − (1 − (1−τ)²(1 − 2τ))；起步 1 帧蓄力，30 fps 下至少 2 个运动帧、1 个中间位帧，邻行入画、运动模糊开——**是滚筒反转，不是跳切、不是淡入**；到位回弹 3.7% 行距（<8%），D 帧 p 恰好 = N、速度 0。
7. **锁定**（D，30 fps 第 j 帧）：闪白 0.14·e^(−j)（j<4）；屏震 y [8,−5,3,−1.5,0.5,0]、x [−3,2,−1,0.5,0,0] px@1080；色差 6·e^(−j/1.3) px；字色 mix(白热, 锁定黄, easeOutQuad(j/4))（j2 过半、j4 满黄）；缩放 1.04 + 0.08·e^(−j/2)·cos(0.8j)，**以字左缘为锚**；外扩环 0.35×字号·easeOutCubic(j/10)；粒子 12 颗、寿命 14 帧、最远 <画面 1/3；光晕 α 0.18+0.37e^(−j/4)，j>12 后以 1.2 s 周期 ±0.04 呼吸。框体退场：j0 选中线闪成锁定色 → j1–5 淡出；j0–6 框底与遮罩淡出；邻行 j0–3 淡出；j1–9 导轨/端盖外移 14 px 淡出。最后只剩字和常驻光晕。
8. **签名**：D+0.10 s 起 0.30 s 从左向右遮罩擦出（easeOutCubic），不发声。
9. **定格** HOLD = 1.00 s → **统一退场** X0（或 `--exit-at`）0.50 s：按 前半句→锁定字→后缀→副标题 逐字向基线压扁（间隔 min(0.025, 0.28/(字数−1)) s，每字 0.20 s）；accent 下划线从中心伸到整行再收成一点；光晕淡掉、签名反向擦掉；E 帧起纯背景，正片硬切接上（E 尽量落拍）。

**时间不变量**
- **锁定 D 由这部片子的音乐落点决定**（样片 D=3.30 s / 30fps f99 只是例子）；音画差 ≤ ½ 帧。
- Rs→D 约 1.38 s（三段：1.03 + 0.19 + 0.16）；**可见滚动（起转到反差词落定）≥1.0 s，不可再压**。
- 反差停顿尽量盖住 D 前一拍（样片 3.06 s 拍落在停顿内）。
- 时长不够时的压缩顺序（每步都试排，首字落到强拍就停）：OPEN 0.16 → 0.14 → 0.12 → CHAR_SETTLE 0.10 → 0.067 → 光标先闪 1 拍 → 0 → ROLL3 0.95 → BACK 0.15；仍放不下就报错（片头前加静音/黑场，或换更晚的重拍），不偷偷挤字。
- 打字弹出曲线、锁定冲击表、版式网格、选中带尺寸、签名位置按上文数值，不随片子改。

## 6. Camera grammar
- 镜头锁死不动：唯一的「镜头」感是锁定 j0–j5 的屏震。不推不拉不摇。
- 已知缺口（见 §11）：动效闸门要求的镜头语言、铺垫拍在这个片头里没有做，评分因此 <90。若某部片需要镜头运动，只能加在整个片头外层（不改内部时刻），并在该片自己的文档里记录。

## 7. Sound palette
全部代码合成（48 kHz），**声音第一个采样 = 画面事件那一帧的起点，偏移 0 ms**：
- 打字 tick：每字一声（2.5–5 kHz 带通噪声 + 2400 Hz 正弦，30 ms，−12 dBFS，声像随字 x 在 ±0.3 间）。
- 框展开 whoosh：Bo，400→2500 Hz 上扫，−24 dB。
- 正滚过格 tick：越过 1..N 每格一声（1200·1.02^(k−1) Hz，−16 → −11 dB 渐响）；第 N 声 = 主题词经过。
- 反差落定 `nope`：800 Hz 闷 tick（−15 dB）+ 35 ms 后 520→700 Hz 小上滑「?」（−24 dB）——被否定的选择。
- 旋回：Rh 处 2800→900 Hz 下扫 whoosh（−22 dB，长 = BACK）；反向越回 N 一声 tick。
- 锁定 impact：只在 D（次低频 70→45 Hz + 噪声瞬态 + 1760/2637 Hz 铃尾，0.9 s，−6 dB）。
- 后缀 / 副标题 tick −16 / −18 dB；退场 whoosh 2500→500 Hz（−26 dB）；E−1 帧 880 Hz blip（−22 dB）。
- 总线峰值压到 −1 dBFS。接 BGM 时：歌约 −12 dB，D−0.03 → D+0.45 再闪避约 −5 dB 给 impact 让位，限幅器要补偿前瞻延迟（否则整轨推后 5 ms）；成片按 lemo 流程到 −14 LUFS。**配乐必须有授权证明才能用于对外版本。**
- 本库公开 test.mp4 **无 BGM、仅合成音效**（且公开站会再剥掉音轨）。内审样片用过的 We Never 无授权证明，未入库。

## 8. Native moves
1. **反差选择 → 旋回主题词**（本条目的签名动作）：滚过主题词 → 反差词停稳可读 → 反转回主题词 → D 锁定。
2. **主题词参数化**（数字和词同等）：
   - 主接口：`--prefix --values --contrast --suffix --sub --drop --skin --aspect`（另有 `--fps --exit-at --beats --bpm`）。**`--values` 是主模型**：逗号分隔，按滚动顺序列出，**末项就是主题词**。
   - `--from/--to/--unit` 只是数字序列的便利写法（`--from 2 --to 10 --unit 倍` = `--values 2倍,…,10倍`），不是主模型。
   - 数字例：`--prefix 如果你的反应快 --values 2倍,3倍,4倍,5倍,6倍,7倍,8倍,9倍,10倍 --contrast 1倍`，锁定 10倍。
   - 词例：`--prefix 如果你能 --values 加速,倒流,跳过,复制,暂停 --suffix 时间 --contrast 加速`，锁定 暂停。
   - 再如：`--prefix 我们 --values 偶尔,经常,总是,永远 --contrast 偶尔`（锁定 永远）；`--prefix 这一次 --values 赢,输 --contrast 赢`（短词表同样成立：滚动时长不变，仍 ≥1 s，只是每格停得更久；这两个例子尚未渲过样片）。
3. **反差词默认规则**（都可用 `--contrast` 覆盖）：
   - 主题词是「数字+单位」（正则 `^\d+`）：默认「1+单位」；主题本身是 1+单位时用「10+单位」。（10倍→1倍；1倍→10倍；100%→1%）
   - 主题词是词：默认取词表里**第一个与主题词不同的词**（暂停→加速）。
   - 选反差词的原则：和主题词意思相反或差距最大、一眼能读懂「不是它」；字数尽量和主题词相同。
4. **反差词的位置**：接在词表**末尾**作为第 N+1 行（不替换原表），所以它可能在正滚途中已出现过一次（词例里的「加速」），这是允许的。
5. **踏拍打字**、**光标变形成选中带**、**黄锁定冲击**、**签名擦出**、**压扁退场 + 下划线**：每部片都一样，是厂牌认得出来的那几下。
6. 新皮肤：复制一个皮肤对象，只改字体、配色和材质绘制函数；不碰任何时间、位移、缩放、透明度曲线（像素皮肤的 1/24 量化是材质处理，不改时刻）。

## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
- 滚动太快或太短（一帧跳一个、0.45 s 滚完）观众看不出是滚出来的 → 可见滚动 ≥1 s，邻行 d=1 保留 45% 透明度、90% 大小。
- 渐显出字会出现半个字 → 不透明度恒 1，只用缩放/下坠入场。
- 新字放大时盖住前一个字 → 新字先画、旧字后画。
- 反差停顿期如果变黄、闪白或响 impact，就成了「锁定两次」→ 停顿期严禁任何锁定元素。
- 旋回做成跳切或淡入 → 必须是滚筒反向运动，有中间位、有模糊、有邻行。
- 运动模糊判据用 ±½ 帧差分，会让停顿最后一帧误开模糊出重影 → 用快门内实际位移判断。
- 运动模糊用普通叠加会让静止字变暗 37%；卡通描边直接加法会变灰紫 → 每个采样独立画到临时层再加法平均。
- 锁定放大以字中心为锚会压到前半句 → 左缘锚。
- 9:16 第二行按字高排会让框压住第一行 → 按框高排。
- 24 fps 下固定字距会两字同帧 → 一帧最多一字，细分不够就换更密细分或报错。
- 限幅器前瞻会把整条混音推后 5 ms → 补偿。
- 字更宽的字体会被 0.88W 限宽自动缩字号，坐标跟着变（时间不变）。
- 词表里词长差距太大时，滚动中框会显得空、选中带两侧不平衡 → 尽量同字数。

## 10. Engine
- demo/：`opener.html`（页面 + 字体）、`opener.js`（引擎，全部不变量在常量 `C` 里；`init(P)` 排时间线与版式，`frame(i)` 出第 i 帧，`describe(i)` 出逐帧描述）、`skins.js`（四个皮肤）、`render.py`（一条命令出片，库内精简版**不接 BGM**）、`sfx.py`（音效合成）、`build.sh`（一键渲数字例 + 词例并拼成 test.mp4）、`FONTS.md`。
- 依赖：Python 3 + numpy + playwright（Chrome/Chromium）、ffmpeg；字体文件在本地库的 demo/fonts/（公开站不发字体文件，按 FONTS.md 来源下载）。
- 输出：mp4 + 同名 `.timeline.json`（全部时间点、版式坐标、每帧描述、声音事件）+ `.sfx.wav`。1080p 5 秒约 20 秒渲完。
- 自审项（源工作目录的 verify.py）：出字帧 = 设计帧、整字弹出、无半字、滚动 ≥1 s、闪白只在 D、锁定前无黄、反差可读停顿 ≥6 帧且清晰整字、旋回连续、D/D+1/D+3 中心 = 主题词、主题词先经过选中带、锁定声画 ≤5 ms、新字不挡前字、框宽装得下最宽词、整句居中、9:16 第一行不压框。本库两条样片（数字例、词例）均全过。

## 11. Variation space / known gaps
**可以变**：前半句、词表与主题词（数字或词）、反差词、后缀、副标题、D（音乐落点）、退场时刻、帧率（24/30/60，按秒取样）、画幅（16:9 / 9:16）、皮肤（四个现成，可新增）。
**不能变**：阶段顺序、反差不锁定、旋回是滚动、锁定只在 D、锁定黄系、整字原则、版式网格、签名样式与位置、退场方式。

**已知缺口（如实）**
- 动效闸门自评 **65.8 分，未到 90**：镜头基本不动、缺少铺垫拍、次层同帧起步、无四层声画分层验证、kickoff 补写。**这不是已过闸的成片系统**，是用户认可方向的厂牌动作规范。
- 盲看测试（不知情观众能否读出题目、看出主题词是滚出来的）未做。
- 公开样片无 BGM；内审样片用的 We Never 没有授权证明，**任何带该歌的版本都不能对外发行**，也未入库。
- 反差词接在词表末尾，停顿时框下半是空的，上方能看见主题词在等着（用户已看过，暂时保留）。
- 像素皮肤反差停顿严格判定刚满 6 帧（像素字关平滑，0.4 px 偏移会落成 1 px 跳格）；其余皮肤 7 帧，9:16 为 8 帧。
- 9:16 第一行墨迹底（含 data 辉光）距滚轮框顶只有约 1.6 px，不压但很紧。
- 打字末字到光标变形只隔约 2 帧，放大看无互挡。
- 皮肤亮度：cartoon/data v2 「更明显」主要靠描边与颜色，不是更亮；如需更亮再往白推。

# Cartoon Fun Facts 卡通冷知识 — Style Prompt
Status: draft (not yet approved by the user). Skill: 卡通冷知识短片 (skill-1793643373152). Kit: /workspace/shared/cartoon-facts-kit/

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
Vertical 1080×1920 flat 2D cartoon fun-fact short (30–35 s). One fact per line, one funny metaphor each; hook question shown on screen at once; the ending flips the hook into a gag. Not realistic, not slow push-ins on stills, no characters baked into backgrounds.
## 2. Materials & rendering
Thick dark-brown outlines, flat fills + simple cel shading, big eyes, vector feel. Characters are cutouts (9 poses: neutral, shout, shock, blush, heart-eyes, sweat, attack, wilted, sidekick) moving over 9 illustrated empty backgrounds (base scale 1.2). Floating motes, vignette.
## 3. Colour logic
Hero has its own palette clearly separated from background props. Keyword yellow #ffd21f with ink stroke; red marker for circles/arrows. No gradient text.
## 4. Type & subtitles
ZCOOL KuaiLe 站酷快乐体 (OFL). White pill caption bar at y=1470, 60–64 px, 2–4 characters per block, one yellow keyword per block. Big title at y=430, spring-in then wobble, no full stop. No emoji.
## 5. Motion quality
Nothing still for 1 s; a new action every 0.5–1 s inside a shot. Idle float, squash on pose change, speed lines on entry, starburst hit + shake, zoom punch 1.1. Every cut, pose, title and SFX is cued on real word timings (iron rule: element moves when the keyword is spoken).
## 6. Camera grammar
Hard cut every 1.5–3 s; each fact gets a new background and a new pose.
## 7. Sound palette
Fish Audio drama-3 科普男声, ~4.2–4.5 字/s; BGM ≈ −12 dB with sidechain, ~9 dB under voice; synthesized SFX (sfx_mix.py); total −14 LUFS.
## 8. Native moves
Red marker circle, curved red arrow, yellow/white starburst, 28-slice swim wobble, props in character local space.
## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
Grid-line slicing cuts neighbour limbs; white fringes; black edge at bottom when scaled; starburst too small turns to black ball; yuvj420p output; hero too small (+20%). No clipping/穿模.
## 10. Engine
Single HTML canvas, frame = pure function of t, window.seek/READY/END/EV; Playwright + system Chrome, 30 fps × 6 motion-blur subframes → ffmpeg. Final renders on the Mac mini.
## 11. Variation space / known gaps
Backgrounds generated at low resolution look soft; English version uses Luckiest Guy. Only the 0–15 s opening has been made so far.

## Rules for making a film in this style (user rules)
1. BGM teardown HTML review page first; wait for the human's explicit「通过」.
2. Script + shot plan to the user first; no image gen / voice / spending before confirmation.
3. Make only the 0–15 s opening first; self-review ≥ 90/100 before showing.
4. No clipping (不穿模).
5. Deliver only one 1080p release (H.264 CRF 18–20, yuv420p tv range, AAC) + one preview < 10 MB. Covers 4:3 and 3:4 only.
6. All rendering on the Mac mini. Facts need two independent sources.

# Direct-Etched Film 胶片直刻 — Style Prompt

> Lines scratched straight into dark film stock, dyed by hand, glowing on projection.
> Source: style study of Lemomo *THE NIGHT CLIMB* (https://x.com/lemomo_ai/status/2116717173934825841) — style learning only; never reuse its footage, frames, characters or story.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
A dark, warm-black film frame where every drawing is an **engraved warm-white line**, and each subject carries **one saturated dye** laid in hatching that glows. Everything is redrawn **on twos**, so lines, dye and scratches boil together: it feels hand-made and projected.

Not: a neon/cyberpunk glow look (no clean vector lines, no gradients), not a "vintage film" filter over footage (no sprocket holes, no frame borders, no sepia), not flat motion graphics, not chalkboard (lines are thin and luminous, ground is warm black, not green/grey).

## 2. Materials & rendering
- Ground: warm black `#130f10`; mean frame luma ≈ 29/255, lit area only 1–17 % of the frame.
- Line: warm white `#f5efe2`, median width ≈ 2 px @1080 (detail), outlines 4–10 px; line ends left open, pressure varies.
- Dye: per subject, −60° parallel hatching over a translucent base of the same colour that **spills past the outline**.
- Overlaps brighten (additive / screen), never darken.
- Glow: 6–10 px blur bloom on lines and dye.
- Film damage: many short curved white hair scratches + dust specks, **20–40 per redraw, re-scattered every redraw**.
- Vignette + a warm light leak. No sprocket holes, no frame border.

## 3. Colour logic
- Constants: warm black ground, warm white line.
- **One subject = one dye**: cyan `#3be6d6`, blue `#3585e2`, red `#df3e30`, gold `#e7bc27`. Never two dyes on one subject; never a large dye area that out-weighs the lead (keep secondary fills small).
- The accent the story follows gets the most saturated dye; dim non-leads to 40–60 %.

## 4. Type & subtitles
- Subtitles: warm white, light weight, small glow, bottom centre, never over the lead.
- On-screen words are etched like lines (stroke reveal), not pasted type. Size floors from the director rules (main ≥120 px, sub ≥56, label ≥34 @1080).

## 5. Motion quality
- Boil **on twos**: random seed = floor(frame/2). Lemomo measured at 15 redraws/s; our 24 fps test is 12/s (15/s needs 30 fps — decide per film).
- Motion slow and sparse; one lead at a time, ≤3 moving regions.
- **Keyword hit rule**: the element tied to a spoken keyword moves on that word (±1 frame) with a clearly visible change. Never let the boil hide a weak hit (e.g. test's 「他」 Δ+2 is too weak).

## 6. Camera grammar
- Mostly locked or slow push; hard cuts between ideas; left/right split screen for comparison (you vs him).

## 7. Sound palette
- Loudness −14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1.5 dBTP. Reference ran ≈129 BPM; motion does not need to sit on beats (reference r = −0.07), but keyword hits must sit on speech.
- No whispering, no sudden silence (user rule).

## 8. Native moves
- Hard cut (reference cuts at 14.30 / 23.37 / 30.97 s).
- Left/right split screen for comparisons (reference 15–31 s).
- A line etching itself in, then being dyed with hatching.

## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
- Too much dye area (the test's quilt) steals the lead.
- Hatching too sparse loses the scratched feel; keep it dense, with dark gaps.
- Thin lines vanish at small sizes (mosquitoes): thicken small subjects' outlines.
- Even, uniform glow looks digital; vary it.
- Unseeded randomness breaks parallel rendering.

## 10. Engine
- Canvas 2D hand-drawn per frame + post compositing (glow, scratches, vignette, leak) in the same page; every frame a pure function of t; seeded randomness.
- Render: on the cloud box ≤2 workers (software WebGL, 8 cores); **official renders on the Mac mini** (user rule 2026-11-01).
- H.264 yuv420p bt709 tv, faststart.

## 11. Variation space / known gaps for next version
- Characters: move from round-head stick figures to designed characters with expressions.
- Denser hatching with black gaps; smaller dye areas; varied glow.
- Boil 15/s (30 fps) vs 12/s (24 fps) to decide.
- Add graphic language (rulers, ticks, diagrams) of our own.

# 光点粒子 Breathing Light Particles — STYLE (invariants only)
Learned from Lemomo's 光点粒子 post (style study only). Measurements: /workspace/mosquito-film/styletest2/dots/REPORT.md.

## 1. Essence
Night picture-book. Every subject (people, animals, land, moon, grass) is a cloud of soft glowing dots on near-black. Dots breathe; subjects form by gathering and leave by scattering. Best for lyrical / character stories, nature, night, crowds, migration. **Not**: steps, numbers, dense facts, product UI.
## 2. Materials & rendering
Additive point sprites (bright white core → coloured halo → transparent), `lighter` blending so overlaps brighten. Core radius median 3.5 px @1080 (p25 3.0, p90 5.0); a few big "firefly" dots 1.5×. Extra glow pass: ¼-res blur ≈ 6–10 px @1080 added at 0.5. Faint coloured haze behind dense areas. Vignette.
## 3. Colour
Ground near-black with a cool-green cast, rgb ≈ (4–11, 5–13, 8–12), mean frame luma 12–38/255, pixels >90 only 0.3–12 %. Two-family palette: warm gold/cream for characters, moon, light (#f0dba0 / #e5e3d2 / #c2b28e); muted sage-olive for land, grass, animals, haze (#a7b47f / #9da17e / #777a5a). One accent only when the story needs it (our addition: red #ff6a4a). No saturated rainbow.
## 4. Type
Small bilingual subtitle at bottom centre, cream, no box; titles may be formed of dots at the end. In our films: subtitle ≥56 px @1080, typed 35 ms/char.
## 5. Motion
Every dot: per-dot twinkle ≈1.2 Hz random phase (luma ±2–3 %) + slow global breath ≈0.4 Hz (size ±12 %). Forming: dots fly in on bowed arcs with per-dot delay (0–0.35 s), ease-out. Leaving: dots scatter outward & upward, dim, ease-in. Shape morph = same dots re-targeted (never fade-swap). Outline sampling dense (~30 dots / 100×100 px @1080 on figures) vs ambient (2–5 / 100×100).
## 6. Camera
Mostly locked or very slow push/drift; no hard cuts in the reference (0 detected cuts in 50.6 s) — transitions are particle dispersal / regathering and fades to near-black.
## 7. Sound
Soft music, ~−14 LUFS, motion only loosely follows loudness (r ≈ 0.29). In our films: narration + BGM, keyword → element moves on the word.
## 8. Native moves
Scatter-and-regather transition; firefly stream / comet tail of dots; whole figure breathing; dots shiver = itch/anxiety; dots condense = attention.
## 9. Layout
Big negative space; horizon low (bottom 20–30 % land/grass); subject on thirds.
## 10. Engine
canvas 2D, pure function of t, seeded mulberry32; renders via headless Chrome + ffmpeg on the Mac mini (`demo/render_mac.sh`).
## 11. Don'ts
No line strokes (only dots); no hard cuts; no flat fills; don't copy the reference's girl/deer/moon composition.

# Paper Checklist Explainer 清单讲解 — Style Prompt
Status: approved by the owner 2026-11-03. Replaces 红线火柴人.
License boundary: this look is produced with an engine licensed to the owner only. The engine, its source code and its original docs are never shared or published; this entry holds only our own summary, muted previews and keyframes. To make a film in this style you still need the owner's locally installed engine.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
A vertical explainer that breaks one concept into steps with UI-checklist parts (rounded cards, pill tags, tick lists, bubbles, arrow routes, phone/interface frames) on warm paper, with an original presenter talking from the bottom-right. Not stock motion-graphics templates, not live footage, no logos.
## 2. Materials & rendering
Off-white paper ground with light grain; far layer of pale-grey ridges or mist drifting slowly so the frame is never fully still. Thick ink outlines with offset hard shadows: a paper-cut card feel. Content scaled into the upper-left area to leave the presenter corner free.
## 3. Colour logic
Ink black for outlines and main text; one red for emphasis (keywords, seals, primary buttons, routes); neutral grey only as support. No other hues.
## 4. Type & subtitles
Fonts: Smiley Sans 得意黑 (headlines/captions) and LXGW WenKai 霞鹜文楷 (secondary), both OFL. Captions at the top (~y 330), revealed per character, the spoken character highlighted, keywords red or bold-enlarged. Emphasis devices: tilted red-box "seal", red pill tag, numbered badges 1/2/3. Opinion passages carry a clear red「观点」tag. Brands appear only as text cards.
## 5. Motion quality
Every sentence gets at least one visual action (pop, slide, tick, stamp, connect, count) triggered by a specific spoken character (iron rule). Self-check gates: motion ≥ 4.8, big moments ≥ 0.65/s, calm frames ≤ 27 %, no 2 s gap without a new event. Originality gates: roughly ≥ 40 scene-code lines/s and ≥ 2.5 self-drawn props/mechanisms per second — each script invents its own metaphors.
## 6. Camera grammar
1080×1920, 30 fps, code-only. Safe area y 360–1420; nothing in the right 120 px; bottom-right reserved for the presenter. Light whip between sentences; constant slow push or drift.
## 7. Sound palette
Fish Audio Drama 3 科普男声, whole script in one take, optional slight speed-up (~1.1×; sample_e kept 1.0). Local Whisper per-character alignment checked by CER against the script. Locally synthesized whoosh/pop/ding/stamp SFX on visual events, bus under the voice, near-duplicates merged. Two-pass loudnorm −14 LUFS, TP ≤ −1.5.
## 8. Native moves
Red stamp slam, tick-list fill, numbered badge count, arrow route drawing itself, card flip, presenter pointing at the active card.
## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
Too many reused stock parts fail the originality gate; content under the presenter or caption; dead 2 s stretches; hidden hits during transitions (land the hit before the cut).
## 10. Engine
Owner-licensed local engine (canvas rendering + headless capture + ffmpeg); not shared. Final renders on the Mac mini; one render at a time. Release: H.264 High 4.1 yuv420p tv range CRF 18; mobile CRF 24, ≤3 Mbps, AAC 128k, faststart. Covers 3:4 and 4:3.
## 11. Variation space / known gaps
Presenter: engine-drawn glasses presenter, or the owner's own paper-cut character (sample_e). Pace 20–52 s. Caption lead timing vs on-the-word timing still to settle per film.

## Rules for making a film (owner rules)
1. 12–16 frame stills sheet reviewed before rendering video.
2. Motion and originality gates must pass; at most 4 rounds; never bypass.
3. No upload or publishing until the owner confirms. Facts need sources; no made-up numbers.

# Pixel RPG 2.5D Explainer 像素RPG 2.5D 科普 — Style Prompt

> A "what if you…" explainer told like a 16-bit RPG: pixel characters act it out on a 2.5D stage, the game UI does the explaining.
> Source: our own finished film《如果你的反应快10倍》v7 (2026-11-10). Story adapted from Ifverse (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MroF1XmHOZw), adaptation reference only. Never reuse its footage, frames or shots.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not
Second-person hypothetical science told as a game. "You" are a chibi pixel hero. Every claim is **acted out as a scene**, and **RPG UI** spells out the point: status panels, dialogue boxes, choice boxes, tag panels. Slow motion is shown as "bullet time": the world crawls while a real-time clock barely moves.

Not: a retro filter over footage. Not a flat 2D slideshow (the layers sit at different depths and the camera moves through them). Not a game trailer (there's no gameplay loop; the UI exists to explain). Not chiptune-only (the narration leads).

## 2. Materials & rendering
- Pixel layers (sprites, tiles, UI) from the Lemo official **pixel-rpg** set, placed on z-layers in a **Three.js 2.5D (WebGPU)** scene: foreground / middle ground / background parallax.
- Native canvas **640×360**, upscaled with **integer ×3 nearest-neighbour** to 1920×1080. No smoothing, no sub-pixel text.
- Characters: parametric chibi rig (lean, reach, crouch, expressions), with thick dark outlines.
- Post: greyscale "freeze" that keeps colour only on the hero layer (used for decision moments); light grain.

## 3. Colour logic
- Palette: ENDESGA-32 (as recorded in the kickoff notes).
- UI: dark navy panels with a cyan edge. Yellow is reserved for the key number or the chosen option (the "10倍", the selected choice, the bullet-time target). Amber marks warnings and results; red marks "回放", REC and danger.
- In decision moments the world turns grey and the hero stays in colour.

## 4. Type & subtitles
- Font **Fusion Pixel 12px** (OFL), drawn on its native grid and upscaled by integers only.
- Size floors @1080: title 180 px (×5), choice / key words 144 px (×4), big numbers 144 px, subtitles and panel text 72 px (×2), labels 36 px (×1).
- **Text appears as whole characters only.** Short labels, card lines and quotes **pop in whole** (a half-typed short word reads as cut off). Long subtitles may chunk in.
- A panel opens first (fast, about 0.1 s), then its text. Never show an empty box or a lone quote mark.
- Subtitles: white with a dark outline, bottom centre, chunked by clause, never over the action.

## 5. Motion quality
- Every frame is a pure function of t (single clock, seeded randomness).
- Big actions get anticipation and settle; impacts get a shake and stars.
- Irritation and boredom are shown by **hard cuts every 0.7–1.5 s** between small hero actions (yawn, anger mark, fidget scribble), not by one long held shot.
- Keep ≤3 moving regions and no uniform motion longer than 0.5 s (the self-check still flags about 3% of frames).

## 6. Camera grammar
- Push-ins and slow pans on camPath keys; hard cuts between ideas; close-ups for "friend 0.25秒 / you 0.025秒" comparisons.
- High shot → hard cut to a low shot when a falling object must read clearly against a character (keep a visible gap; never cover a face).
- Characters stay ≥24 px (1080p) from the frame edge. A ≤0.2 s pan entry is tolerated.

## 7. Sound palette
- Fish Audio drama-3 narration, normal volume and clear voice (**no whispering or lowered voice**).
- CC0 Freesound SFX on every UI action: typing ticks, wheel ticks, panel pop, slam, cheer, "叮" for a reward.
- The BGM's four layers (low / rhythm / melody / ambience) were analysed and drive four visual layers.
- Mix −14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≈ −1.4 dBFS.

## 8. Native moves
- **Slot-wheel title**: "如果你的反应快" types in at 0.04 s per character. Then a reel window with steel rails, end caps, top/bottom fade masks and an amber selection band rolls 2倍 → 10倍 and locks in yellow with a glow. The reel furniture fades out after the lock. Full timing/visual spec: see the section below and `TITLE_ANIMATION.md`（逐字整字弹出每字0.04s+打字声 → 「快」打完后 2.05–3.08s 减速滚动 2倍→10倍、相邻行淡出、8声滚轮tick → 3.08–3.30s 过冲回弹吸附 → 3.30s 卡音乐drop锁定变黄发光，主标题≈180px、副标题≈108px）.
- **Bullet-time beat** in three shots: setup (e.g. "苍蝇来袭 / 朋友：啪！没打中", MISS) → bullet time (tag panel "子弹时间 ×0.1 + one-line rule", top-right "现实时间 0.05秒" barely moving, yellow target ring + dashed path, hero reaches first) → result tag ("获得：苍蝇 ×1" / "一滴没洒") + the friend's "？？？".
- **Status panel**: "状态 / 反应速度 ×1 → ×10" with a filling bar and stars.
- **Choice box**: two options, a white cursor arrow, a yellow selection fill, and a countdown "剩余0.xx秒" **inside** the box at bottom-right.
- **Bet / challenge segments**: speech bubbles, a score pill ("你 1:0 朋友"), and a pay-off (the friend hands over the milk tea).
- **Replay screen**: a filled screen with a solid header bar ("回放" badge + REC dot + timecode) and "×0.1 慢放" in a corner.
- Cold-open freeze on the decision, then a pixel-mosaic transition into the title.

### 开头标题出现动画（滚轮标题）——设计规范

来源：用户给的参考图方案（逐字打出 + iOS 式滚轮滚到「10倍」），v7 定稿实际做法。以下数值取自 v3–v7 制作记录；渲染源码已删除，只能按本文重做。

#### 时间线（片内绝对时间，24fps）
| 时间 | 发生什么 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|
| 0–约1.8 s | 冷开场：决定瞬间定格 + 选择框（钩子），像素马赛克转场进标题 | — |
| 约1.0–2.0 s | 「如果你的反应快」逐字出现，每字 0.04 s；每个字**整字弹出**（不渐显、不出半个字），每字一声打字「咔」 | 打字 tick |
| 2.05 s | 「快」字必须已经打完，滚轮才开始 | — |
| 2.05–3.08 s | 滚轮从 2倍 往上滚到 10倍：先快后慢（减速缓动），相邻上下两行数字可见并逐渐淡出，每过一格一声「嗒」，全程约 8 声 | 滚轮 tick ×8 |
| 3.08–3.30 s | 惯性过冲一点再回弹吸附（snap）到 10倍 | 最后一声 tick |
| 3.30 s | 锁定：正好卡在音乐 drop 上；「10倍」变黄并发光；滚轮外框淡出 | drop |
| 之后 | 副标题出现 | — |

#### 视觉构成
- 字体：Fusion Pixel 12px（OFL），整数倍放大，不做亚像素平滑。
- 主标题字号约 180 px（1080p 下），白字 + 深色投影；副标题约 108 px，白色。
- 「10倍」锁定后：黄色 + 外发光，居中偏大。
- 滚轮外框：钢质导轨（左右 rails）+ 上下端盖 + 上下渐隐遮罩 + 琥珀色选中带；相邻行用遮罩淡出，不能缩成看不清的小字。
- 锁定后滚轮外框淡出，只留下标题文字。

#### 验收（每次必须逐帧核对）
1. 抽 2.0–3.4 s 每帧拼图，能看到数字是**一格一格连续滚上来**，不是一帧跳一个数。
2. 滚动时间 ≥ 1 s，有减速，有过冲回弹。
3. 「快」字打完前滚轮不能动；任何一帧不能出现半个字或残留符号。
4. 锁定帧落在音乐 drop 上（误差 ≤ 1 帧）。
5. 找不知情的观看者盲看，确认能说出「10倍是滚出来的」。

#### 踩过的坑
- v2：一帧跳一个数字、0.45 s 就滚完，相邻行太小 → 观众看不出在滚动（用户退回）。
- v4：标题下面残留小符号；字是渐显的，会出现半个字 → v5 改成整字弹出。

## 9. Pitfalls of the medium
- A half-typed short label ("只有1", "只掉3") reads as truncated: pop it whole.
- An empty or thin panel frame reads as a glitch: gate the text on the panel being fully open.
- A cropped prop reads as UI (a half movie car read as a "progress bar"): draw it only when it's whole in frame, or cut it.
- Colour-noise strips between badges read as an empty box: use solid bars.
- A timer pressed against a box edge: put it inside the box.
- A falling object over a face, or characters touching the frame edge.
- Character legs merging into a dark car body / subtitle band: stand the character on visible ground with a shadow, above the subtitle zone.
- Code: never leave a trailing `//` comment mid-line in generated code; run `node --check` every time.

## 10. Engine
- Three.js (WebGPU) 2.5D stage with Lemo official pixel-rpg layers. The render page exposes `render(t)`; Playwright drives headless Chrome (SwiftShader WebGPU on the box), and frames are piped to **ffmpeg** (H.264 yuv420p bt709 tv, CRF18, faststart; 720p preview ~750 kbps).
- QA: a per-frame text scanner (overlap / cut / text-over-panel / empty panel / character edge), a motion verifier with four-layer ablation renders, and loudness checks.
- **The render source of the reference film was deleted at the owner's request (2026-11-10).** Only the cover generator survives (demo/).

## 11. Variation space / known gaps
- The motion self-check never reached 90 (71.25: static holds, breath bars, layer-timing misses). Next film: design breath bars and layer entries into the timeline from the start.
- BGM licence: use a track with licence proof so the public version can have sound.
- Topics: any "what if you were 10× faster / stronger / smaller…" hypothetical, reaction / speed / perception explainers.
- 未提供: a vertical 9:16 version of the stage, and tested durations other than about 2 min.
- Later brand title openers follow the separate entry `brand-title-opener` (contrast pick, then spin back to the theme word; the theme word can be a word, not only a number). This film's own v7 title history above is unchanged.

One example only. Don't reuse its story, shots or timings.

- Example film: our《如果你的反应快10倍》v7 (about 2 min, 1920×1080, 24 fps). The story is adapted from Ifverse (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MroF1XmHOZw), **adaptation reference only**; no Ifverse footage or frames are in this library.
- test.mp4: the first 14 s of v7 (cold-open choice box → slot-wheel title → office bullet-time beats), 960×540, 24 fps, **muted**. The BGM "We Never" has no licence proof, so no public file carries sound.
- test.jpg: the locked title "如果你的反应快10倍" (3.3 s). styleframe.jpg: a bullet-time shot (6.5 s).
- **The render source (Three.js scene, film timeline, engine copy, audio mixer, QA scanners) was deleted at the owner's request on 2026-11-10. The film cannot be re-rendered from this library.** Don't pretend otherwise; rebuild new films from STYLE.md.
- demo/ (what still exists):
  - `make_covers_v7.py`: generates the cover family (black grain card + choice-box frame + Fusion Pixel text) in 3:4, 4:3, 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, and asserts the safe area / overlaps for every text box.
  - `build.sh`: runs it. Needs the Fusion Pixel TTF (OFL, download it from the official repo) and the approved cover-B image (kept in the final package, not in the library). It was tested on 2026-11-10 and reproduced all 5 covers byte for byte.
  - `cover_check.json`: the text boxes, safe areas and minimum edge distances of the v7 covers.
- The final package (film, covers, PUBLISH.md) stays local in /workspace/finals/reaction-10x-worldcup-v7/ and is not published.
